newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy interest rate cut seen possible if cpi drops.
newsitem.headline: Italy interest rate cut seen possible if cpi drops.

text.p: Italian interest rates could be cut again if, as expected, consumer price inflation continues to fall, Treasury Undersecretary Roberto Pinza said on Tuesday.

"It is up to the Bank of Italy. If inflation falls, interest rates should fall under normal circumstances," Pinza told reporters before attending a meeting between the government and trade unions to dicuss labour market reforms.

Shortly afterwards Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said he was convinced year-on-year inflation in Italy would fall to below two percent when preliminary April inflation figures are released next week.

Italian shares and bond futures have all firmed on expectations of an April year-on-year CPI rate of 1.9 percent, down from 2.2 percent in March, fuelling hopes that the central bank could cut interest rates. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
